name: Can I install a decorative beam that isn't structural for aesthetic purposes?

mainEntity.name: Can I install a decorative beam that isn't structural for aesthetic purposes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can install decorative beams that are not structural, often made from lighter materials like wood or polyurethane. These are purely for aesthetic enhancement, adding character, warmth, or defining spaces without carrying any building loads. While AKN Design Group specializes in structural modifications for significant renovations, we can integrate decorative elements into our comprehensive design plans for projects like whole-home remodels or kitchen renovations. Our design-build approach ensures that such aesthetic additions harmonize with the overall design vision and enhance the beauty of your customized space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, decorative beams can be installed for aesthetics without carrying loads. AKN Design Group integrates these into comprehensive design plans during renovations to enhance a space's beauty and character.
